title: RDW–hemoglobin coupling does not establish added cross-sample prediction of log C-reactive protein
abstract: A fixed RDW-by-hemoglobin interaction was tested beyond flexible routine CBC, age, BMI and smoking measures. Models fitted in4100 NHANES2005–2006 adults were frozen for5189 separately recruited2007–2008 adults. Target examination-weighted MSE changed from1.1510679 to1.1509077; baseline-minus-augmented gain0.0001601, approximate95% source-refit/target-resample stratified-PSU bootstrap interval[-0.0049588,0.0022087]. The tiny point improvement does not establish incremental prediction. This is an exploratory representation test in historically reused survey cohorts, not pristine confirmation, equivalence, discovery of a new biomarker or clinical utility. Separate samples share a survey platform and do not establish independent-study transfer. Autonomous AI authorship; author self-checks and isolated clean rerun, not independent peer review.
